description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated test cases for verifying the behavior of the 'git worktree prune' command, including various scenarios such as pruning directories, handling unreadable or invalid gitdirs, duplicate worktree detection, and specific exclusion conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the executed command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path exists and is a directory.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in specified directory.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository, optionally from a specified path or branch.
